query:
INSERT INTO faculties (code, name_ru, name_kk, name_en, active)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
         ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE
             SET name_ru = EXCLUDED.name_ru,
                 name_kk = EXCLUDED.name_kk,
                 name_en = EXCLUDED.name_en,
                 active = EXCLUDED.active
         RETURNING id
